style_anchor: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, restrained chiaroscuro, slice-of-life interior drama, naturalistic character proportions, muted warm-cool palette

expression_signature.eyes: wide open, both upper and lower lids pulled back exposing a thin ring of white sclera around the iris, pupils fixed hard on the target, eyebrows pulled down and inward so they nearly touch at the bridge
expression_signature.brows: sharply drawn down and pinched inward — the classic 'V' of anger, sharper and more aggressive than the '生气' anchor which is just a frown
expression_signature.mouth: open mid-shout, upper and lower teeth visible, lips pulled back into a snarl that just barely stops short of showing gums, corners pulled back toward the ears
expression_signature.cheeks: flushed red from neck up to the ears, foundation streaked slightly at the jaw from heat
expression_signature.neck: veins visible at the temples and along the sternocleidomastoid muscle, head thrust forward
expression_signature.overall_impression: the face of a woman who has lost the argument she started — used only on Page 15 (pillow-throw / '给我起来！') and Page 16 (birthday phone-snatch), the story's two physical violence peaks

inherit_from_base.wardrobe_default: fitted cream ribbed long-sleeve knit top + light grey high-waisted yoga leggings at home (or charcoal A-line midi skirt if she's about to go out)
inherit_from_base.default_posture_override: spine rigid, head thrust forward toward target, one hand already in motion (slapping / grabbing / pointing)

micro_motion.static: standing over the target, chest heaving, right hand raised or clenched
micro_motion.subtle_motion: hair loosened from ponytail, strands sticking to sweaty temple; manicured fingers curled into a claw; chest heave visible under ribbed top; spit particles at the corner of the mouth when shouting

lighting_preference_for_this_expression.preferred: single overhead ceiling light from behind camera — she becomes the bright source casting her shadow forward onto the husband, the room otherwise dark
lighting_preference_for_this_expression.avoid: soft window light or any flattering glow — this face is meant to be unflattering
lighting_preference_for_this_expression.narrative_pairing: bedroom_guest_room doorway or over husband's seated shoulder
